dogecoin.text: The co-creator of the meme-inspired cryptocurrency dogecoin, made a rare return to Twitter with this harsh thread about crypto in general

In Wall Street speak, it’s known as the puke. It’s the capitulation of people insistent on selling at any price. When they dump their mutual funds and ETFs and dogecoin at any price, when we see redemptions run amok, that’s when we’ll be near the bottom https://t.co/pTE2lBdxaW
